newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPGs mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPGs mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were mixed in quiet dealings late on Monday as NYMEX November crude oil futures eked out slight gains, players said.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, on the Gulf Coast, propane edged up a quarter cent to between 48.75 cents and 49.00 cents a gallon.
Conway, Kansas, hub material remained largely at 45.50/45.75 cents, with 45.63 traded, players said.
"The market tried to come off earlier today, but then buyers came back in," said one Midwest trader.
Trading in much of the energy complex was rendered light by the Jewish holiday Yom Kippur.
Meanwhile, Belvieu ethane purity edged down a quarter cent to 28.50/28.75 cents, and Conway normal butane rose 0.25 cent in thin talk.
-- Laney Salisbury New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
